messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up: PartnerX asked for a concise onboarding playbook to wire Redwood hosted/dedicated into their VPCs and to publish a marketplace listing. Need scope + owners.
Jordan Patel: I can pick up the Terraform connector module. Prefer a single module with a mode var (hosted | private). Will add support for container_image or image_id inputs.
Sam Lee (Partner): PartnerX constraints: must use PrivateLink for traffic, minimal IAM for cross-account role, and a verification step that confirms egress is blocked except to our endpoint.
Devon Li: I'll draft the reference archs (AWS PrivateLink + GCP PSC) and a one-page mermaid diagram. Also will include a KMS note for key wraps.
Maria Gomez: Scope idea: 1) reference arch (AWS, GCP), 2) terraform module + examples, 3) sample app (python) that does auth + streaming, 4) publishing checklist for marketplace, 5) CI smoke tests and an acceptance test matrix.
Jordan Patel: TF sketch in-thread: ```hcl
variable "mode" { type = string default = "hosted" }
variable "partner_account_id" { type = string }
variable "container_image" { type = string optional = true }
resource "aws_ecs_task_definition" "connector" { /* optional */ }
```
Jordan Patel: Plan to add a local CI run that uses a replay server (recorded inference responses) so we don't hit live tokens in CI.
Alex Chen: Timeline ask from PartnerX: partner preview in 10 business days. Can we commit?
Maria Gomez: Internal review in 5 business days, partner preview day 10. I'll open the repo scaffold today with ISSUE_TEMPLATE and checklist.
marketplace-bot: Created repo redwood/partnerx-onboard-playbook and added ISSUE_TEMPLATE + SECURITY.md.
Sam Lee (Partner): We'll supply minimal IAM policy snippet and PrivateLink acceptance tests (curl + header expectations). Also can provide target account IDs.
Devon Li: Note: region matrix required — some regions don't offer PrivateLink or ARM64 AMIs. Will add a table in README.
Jordan Patel: CI matrix will include linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 tests and a smoke-run against the replay server.
Maria Gomez: Action items: Jordan = TF module + examples; Devon = diagrams + README region matrix; Alex = marketplace packaging notes + release checklist; Sam = IAM snippet + test steps. I'll schedule 30m sync Fri.
Sam Lee (Partner): Sending IAM snippet and test checklist today. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Jordan Patel: Draft PR for the module by EOD tomorrow. Will tag reviewers.
Maria Gomez: Great. Call out risk: Private connectivity flakiness and cross-account role perms. We'll add troubleshooting steps.
Alex Chen: LGTM. :rocket:
